fixture_policy: Source literal/structural chemistry assertions are inline and source-reviewed. External TSV is actual execution of the exact extracted massDeltaText_ formatter helper only. No native Rust output generated expected values; no C++ full SDK or conversion algorithm execution claimed.

formatter_probe.inputs: Both signs of zero, minimum subnormal, largest subnormal, minimum normal, maximum finite, neighbors of explicit decimal/2^52/2^53/large-integral values, plus 512 steps of the documented 64-bit integer recurrence filtered to finite magnitudes; deduplicated and sorted.
formatter_probe.stand_in: Only OpenMS exception construction and OPENMS_PRETTY_FUNCTION use a small standard-library stand-in; finite source helper body is extracted unchanged.
formatter_probe.native_assertion: Every row exercises complete from_aa_sequence and lossless writer/parser. Input record declares positive absolute residue mass independently of diff mass, preserving existing AASequence cached-mass validity for negative extremes.

implemented_scope: Four source AASequence conversion functions plus native explicit-policy/default wrappers; already available resolver remains reused.
Existing three policies and all conversion issue variants, complete source combination/reverse helpers and owned diagnostics.
preserved_cpp_issues: CPP-029: annotations-only ordinary bracket passes issues/can but strict null-handle attachment throws.
CPP-030: terminal crosslink label omitted from issue checking and attachment.
CPP-031: empty public ambiguous section advances cursor without emitting residue; checked index error retained.
CPP-037: charged formula combination canonicalizes to neutral text and loses PROTON_MASS_U; direct source-reviewed AST formula and mass-difference regression.
native_differences: Immutable inputs and caller-owned registry transaction; every Err rolls back, completed issues/can reports commit formula interning.
Owned typed resolution/formula-disagreement warnings replace global logging.
Existing deterministic provider-first DB lookup replaces C++ allocation-dependent pointer ordering; no public lookup policies changed.
Existing native AASequence grammar, known/unknown chemistry, nonnegative cached-mass and finite/count bounds remain inherited.
Native anonymous MassTag reverse conversion materializes owned records; absolute B/Z/X locally derives source-zero-base delta as internal target + H2O without changing public MassTag availability.

Conservative cumulative logical bounds and safe index errors replace undefined overflow/unchecked allocation. Integral finite mass text uses exact fixed zero precision; 1078 source outputs verify fractional/integral formatting.
remaining_scope: Ordinary and XLMS spectrum operation groups; overall ProForma header remains partial.
licensing: Source-derived native code and source formatter extraction retain OpenMS BSD-3-Clause provenance; no new dependency.
